episode.title: A Decision About Bristol
intro: Leo thinks about both cities and makes a choice. He thanks his former manager and says no to the Bristol role. He wants to grow his skills in Kyoto. One day, he hopes to open a small bakery. Claire and Nao feel happy for him.
レオは二つの街について考え、決断します。元店長に感謝し、ブリストルの仕事は断ります。京都で技術を伸ばしたいです。いつか小さなパン屋を開く希望もあります。クレアとナオも喜びます。
goal: I can distinguish an offer, a deadline, and a final decision in work messages.
仕事の連絡を読み、オファー、返答期限、最終的な決断を区別できる。
episode.warmup: Which words show a final decision in a message?
words: I have decided to stay in Kyoto.
決断しました（京都に残ると決めました）。
Thank you for the opportunity to work in Bristol.
I need to decline the offer.
I want to develop my skills at my current bakery.
I hope to open a small bakery someday.
discussion: You are Leo. Your tutor is your former manager. Thank him, say your decision clearly, and give two reasons for staying in Kyoto.
あなたはレオ役、講師は元店長役です。感謝し、決断をはっきり伝え、京都に残る理由を2つ言いましょう。
episode.followup: How can you talk about a long-term hope without saying it is confirmed?

rule: "I have decided to ..." shows a final decision. "I hope to ..." shows a hope, not a plan.
I have decided to ... は決断。I hope to ... は希望で、確定ではありません。
examples: I have decided to stay in Kyoto.
京都に残ると決めました。

rule: "By Friday" is a reply deadline. It is not a start date.
by Friday は返答の期限で、開始日ではありません。
examples: 金曜日までに返事をください。

situation: Read the messages. Identify Leo’s decision and the deadline.
メッセージを読みます。レオの決断と期限を確認しましょう。
apply.text:
Former manager to Leo
We would love you to help open the Bristol bakery. Please let me know by Friday whether you accept. We can discuss the starting date after that.

Leo's confirmation after the call
Thank you for the opportunity. As we discussed, I have decided to stay in Kyoto, so I need to decline the role. I want to develop my skills at my current bakery and build my life here. I hope to open a small bakery someday, but I have not made a business plan yet. I appreciate your support.

Manager's reply
I understand. I wish you success in Kyoto. Thank you for telling me clearly.
questions: What is Friday the deadline for?
Telling the manager whether Leo accepts the offer.
Has a starting date been agreed?
No. It will be discussed after acceptance.
He will stay in Kyoto and decline the Bristol role.
Has Leo arranged to open his own bakery?
No. It is only a hope. He has no business plan yet.

choose: I have decided (to stay / staying) in Kyoto.
I need to (decline / declined) the offer.
I want to develop (my / me) skills.
I hope (to open / open) a bakery someday.
choices: "I have decided to stay and decline the role." What is confirmed?
Leo has accepted the Bristol job.
"Reply by Friday; discuss the start later." What is Friday?
"I hope to open a bakery someday." What is true?
A shop opening next Monday is confirmed.
Which reason comes from Leo's reply?
He wants to develop his skills at his current bakery.
He has already bought a new shop.

situation: You are Leo. Your tutor is Claire. Read the follow-up messages after you decline Bristol. Explain what is confirmed and correct a rumor.
あなたはレオです。講師はクレアです。ブリストルを断った後の連絡を読み、確定したことを説明し、うわさを訂正しましょう。
task: Confirm the tray times, the return deadline, and the meeting plan next week. Separate your hope from an unconfirmed shop opening.
トレーの受け取り時間、返却期限、来週の打ち合わせ予定を確認します。希望と未確定の開店を分けて説明しましょう。
mission.text:
Current bakery manager
You can collect two display trays on Friday after 5 p.m. Please return them on Monday before noon. Your small pastry stall is approved for Saturday's market.

Next week
Come to the bakery on Wednesday at 3 p.m. We can discuss how you could develop a seasonal recipe. This is a planning meeting, not permission to open a separate shop.

Leo to the market group
I am staying in Kyoto, but I have not rented a shop or set an opening date. Opening my own bakery is a future hope. For now, I am preparing for Saturday and continuing my current job.
mission.title: After the Decision - Confirmed and Unconfirmed
lines: When can you collect the trays, and how many trays are there?
When do you need to return the trays?
Is your pastry stall approved for Saturday’s market?
What time is your meeting next Wednesday, and what is it about?
Someone said you will open your own shop next week. Is that confirmed?
Please tell me one thing that is definite and one thing that is only a hope.
mission.evidence: Tutor evidence note: The text says two trays can be collected Friday after 5 p.m. and returned Monday before noon. The Saturday pastry stall is approved. The Wednesday 3 p.m. meeting is about developing a seasonal recipe and is only planning, not permission to open a separate shop. Leo has not rented a shop or set an opening date, and he will continue his current job. Do not mix this Friday tray pickup with the separate Bristol reply deadline from earlier.

topics: How can you thank someone before you say no?
What is a clear sentence to decline an offer?
What reason can you give in one short sentence?
What is one next step toward a goal?
How is a hope different from a confirmed plan?
What do you need before you open a shop?
How can you check a rumor politely?
Why should you separate different Friday tasks?
trivia: "By Friday" and "on Friday" are different. "By Friday" is a deadline. You can often do it earlier. "On Friday" happens that day. If time is important, ask for the exact time.
by Friday と on Friday は違います。by Friday は期限で、多くの場合それより前でもOKです。on Friday はその日に行われます。時刻が大事なら、正確な時間も聞きましょう。
triviaQuestion: Can Leo usually send a reply on Thursday if it is due by Friday?
Yes. Thursday is before the deadline.
episode.closing: Leo declines the Bristol role and stays in Kyoto. His current bakery approves his Saturday market stall and will lend two trays. Opening his own bakery is still only a future hope.
